title: Ball Regular Mouth 32-Ounces Mason Jar with Lids and Bands, Clear,(Pack Of 2)
description:
About this item
2-Regular mouth glass preserving mason jars. 2-Regular mouth lids. 2-Regular mouth bands.
Ideal for sliced fruits and vegetables, pickles, tomato-based juices, and sauces.
These jars are BPA-free. Dishwasher Safe and Reusable
New and improved sure tight lids
Helps keep canned food sealed now for up to 18-months
reviews_5s: These are strong glass jars that should keep stored items fresh for a long time.Used them as center pieces for my wedding, and was able to re use them in the kitchen! They don't leak, the quality is what you would expect from a mason jar!I was tired of my dish soap and liquid hand soap manufacturer bottles looked on my kitchen sink. So I bought two regular mouth mason jars (32oz and 16oz) from this seller. The larger one on left in pic is the 33oz that came in a 2 pack and on the right is the 16oz that came in a 3 pack. I wanted to use these for dish and hand soap and they worked out perfectly with these plastic heavy duty pumps I also bought separately from a different seller that fit these standard mouth mason jars. These mason jars are clear glass, and I like that they have the measurements on the side and they are of good quality. I had the dish and hand soap labels already. They did not come with these mason jars. I plan to put two more 16oz jars with pumps in my guest bathroom (one for hand soap and the other for hand lotion). They arrived over night, great packaging and Im very happy with my purchase. I love how my kitchen sink soap bottles match now. I hated having the manufacturer liquid soap bottles on my sink. These looks much nicer and organized. I get lots of compliments on them.This is good for organization, foods, drinks, honestly anything! Great color easy to stack, durable, and so on. I do like this product however glass jars are priceyArrived in good shape and on time.Good price big jarI am highly satisfied with the products I ordered. They were the perfect size. Arrived promptly and intact. Great price, fast delivery=unbeatable experience. Thank you!havent used them yet but will use them in the futureI like the big mouth of the jar, easy to fill.Love these Mason jars. Functionally I use them for my sourdough starter. No leaks yet! They look pretty on the countertop so don't mind leaving them out. I currently use one and the other is very easily stored, stacks nicely in my cabinet. One knocked over on my counter top I thought it was a goner but it's strong and didn't Crack at all. Great deal!
reviews_1s:
Updated review:
These jars are like a comedy routine. After two orders of being sent the wrong jars, I gave up on the two packs and ordered a four pack. FINALLY I got the right jars, and they seal great. BUT I got only two (in a four pack).

Original review:
These jars are decent quality. They are definitely not as heavy as older Ball jars I have.

My big gripe is they arrived packages decently but both lids are dented. The lids also lack the printed date field shown in product photos.

The worst part; the product is advertised as regular mouth, the box reads ‘regular mouth’, and the bubble wrap inside the box has a label that reads ‘regular mouth’. But the jars are wide mouth, with ‘wide mouth’ embossed in the glass.

I even returned these for replacement. Again, the box shows up labeled regular mouth but what was sent was wide mouth jars.They came wrapped and shipped and had small fragments of glass in them. Beware of quality and functionality. Can’t use them if they’re dangerous.I ordered 32oz jars and I got the little ones. Which are like half as expensive and not really what I wanted. I cannot get ahold of anyone at Ball or Amazon and it’s not really worth driving half an hour to return $12 jars.

In other commentary, they’re Bell jars. They’re the most standard jars. They’re going to be as great as literally any jar ever.Click to play video
I threw the broken /crushed jar away. So I probably won’t get a refund since I didn’t keep it to return to Amazon Returns in Kohl’s. I like the jars though but needed 4.I ordered these and they arrived promptly. I live at 6000’ elevation. I’m not sure where these were packed. When I opened and unscrewed the band with seal, they blew off like a bomb. Fortunately I had faced them down instead of up under my face or we’d be having a different conversation! As it was, the lid hit and injured my little finger! IDIOTIC to ship a jar with a seal and band screwed down!I actually purchased these specifically for the Bobby Price detox program, in which you are advised to use 2-"32 oz." Mason Jars. The description is deceiving, and I didn't even realize the size until I had already used the jars so I can't return them. Clearly the photo I attached shows they are actually 24oz jars.
I am very disturbed that I now have to buy more and keep these. I do not use Mason jars.

~Very dissatisfied that I bought these based on the wrong description.I’m sure you have a 24 ounce at home? That’s about as big as these are there’s no way these are 32 ounces. I read the reviews and I thought no way, but yeah 27 oz sent! I’m disgusted my recipes call for 32 ounce liquid to be mixed in a jar there’s no way around it. I’m disgusted they took me for a ride.Unfortunately my order came broken. I had to throw it away because if all the tiny shattered pieces coming out of the box . I am receiving a replacement but hope this time it comes properly shipped .Let me start by saying that the jars are top quality and what one would expect from a Mason jar. The issue here is that they are advertised as 32 once jars, when in fact , the ones I received are 24 once jars. I specifically ordered 32 once containers for a reason. Very disappointed.I bought 4 of them. I press the middle of the lid with a finger, but the lid springs up when i release my finger, it means lid is not sealed. I bought 64 oz ones, they don't have this problem.
